question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.**

 

Cinema show in the afternoon
solution:
The correct answer is **Matinee**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The most appropriate word is **Matinee**.
 
 
• 
 It means an afternoon performance of a play, film. (एक नाटक, फिल्म का दोपहर का प्रदर्शन।)

 
 
• 
 ​For example, The Saturday matinee was so crowded that we had to sit in the second row.
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct option is 3.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
